content: COMPASS v10 SESSION — April 9, 2026. Major work session compressing the compass from Ministral-3B to Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct (4-bit MLX). Training data expanded from 246 examples (v9) to 551 examples (v10) by synthesizing 305 new examples from 6 mirror models: Mistral, ChatGPT, Grok, Gemini, Kimi K2.5, Sonnet. Signal balance: 35% OPEN, 32% PAUSE, 32% WITNESS. CRITICAL BUG FOUND AND FIXED: initial v10 training data used HOLD as the middle signal label, but the canonical compass schema is PAUSE (matches v9 and the action model system prompts). 755 HOLD->PAUSE replacements across the 551 examples corrected the schema. First training run on the buggy data hit 84% on the 19-question eval (16/19 at iter 600) but failed because it learned HOLD while being evaluated against PAUSE. Retrain with corrected labels in progress as of session end. KEY ARCHITECTURAL DECISION: rejected the April 9 morning plan to use ModernBERT-base as an encoder-only classifier. The compass is not a classifier — it is a generator. The ~110 tokens of SHAPE/TONE/SIGNAL/APPROACH become literal attention conditioning text in the 9B action model. An encoder with a 3-class head destroys the mechanism. Qwen2.5-1.5B chosen because it is explicitly trained for structured output generation (JSON/schema), Apache 2.0, native MLX 4-bit weights, ~2.2GB memory (vs 5GB for 3B), ~20-25ms inference (vs 30-40ms for 3B). Training: LoRA with 16 layers, batch size 4, lr 5e-5, 600 iters, max_seq_length 2048, save every 100. Trainable params: 5.276M / 1543.714M (0.342%). Peak memory 11.4GB during training. v9 peaked at iter 300 — v10 expected to peak iter 400-600 due to doubled dataset.
